card.statement:
The total Steenrod power of $x\in H^{*}_{T}(X;k)$ is the composition

(3.13)

$\mathrm{St}^{T}(x):=\Delta^{*}(x_{eq})\in H^{*}_{T\times\mu_{p}}(X;k)\cong H^{*}_{T}(X;k)[\![t,\theta]\!]$

where the last isomorphism is the Künneth isomorphism for the trivial $\mu_{p}$ -action on $X$.

The coefficients in $H^{*}_{T}(X;k)$ of $\mathrm{St}^{T}(x)$ as a polynomial in $t,\theta$ are (up to a sign, see [SW22, Remark 1.3] or [Lon21, Section 2.1]) the usual Steenrod operations on $x$ in singular cohomology with positive characteristic coefficients, hence the name.
card.label: Definition 3.6

paper.title: 3D mirror symmetry in positive characteristic
paper.abstract: Via the formulation of (quantum) Hikita conjecture with coefficients in a characteristic $p$ field, we explain an arithmetic aspect of the theory of 3D mirror symmetry. Namely, we propose that the action of Steenrod-type operations and Frobenius-constant quantizations intertwine under the (quantum) Hikita isomorphism for 3D mirror pairs, and verify this for the Springer resolutions and hypertoric varieties.
